GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: A top 1% food platform for college students. Focus on emotion, energy, and eco-consciousness. Avoid the generic 'red/orange whole-site' fast-food look. Use an 'Oat Milk' warm base to feel premium, accented by an energetic Radish Pink and a crisp Matcha Green. Every page must feel emotionally directed. Prioritize contrast, generous spacing (2-3x standard), and high-density functional bento grids. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

theme_strategy.description: Nature/Food relates closely to light themes. We will use an Oat-Milk base (warm food-inspired neutral) in light mode, preserving the established oat-milk, radish-pink, matcha-green identity.

rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings.
Tight letter spacing on all headings.
No generic 'Bold'—use 'Black' for hero, 'Medium' for body.
Use energetic primary (Radish Pink/Fuchsia) for main CTAs and Mood tags.
Use eco-green (Matcha Green) for Daily Tiffin and Eco Impact indicators.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for sticky headers and bottom navs. 1px bottom/top border required.
visual_enhancers.grain_texture: Subtle noise on hero backgrounds to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, harsh 1px borders for functional cards.

components_and_surfaces.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle nested radii. No generic floaty shadows. Use 1px border border-border with subtle colored shadow on hover.
components_and_surfaces.navbar: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px bottom border. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds.
components_and_surfaces.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Hover: slight scale up and color shift. Explicit hover state styling.
components_and_surfaces.tags: High contrast pills. Background matches category (e.g. green for eco).
components_and_surfaces.modals_toasts: Use Sonner for toasts. Shadcn Dialog for modals. Ensure rounded-2xl.
components_and_surfaces.inputs: Shadcn components heavily styled to match the oat-milk identity. Sharp borders, subtle focus rings.
components_and_surfaces.image_fallback: A generic food patterned background with a centered MoodBite logo icon or a subtle placeholder illustration in Oat-Milk tone when actual food image fails to load.
rules: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/menus.
Use Shadcn UI components for logic, but customize styles heavily.
Avoid generic HTML input/select. Use Shadcn variants.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.app_pages: High Density Grid (Mode B) for dashboard/orders.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content.
grids_and_layouts.hero_overlay: Max overlay bg-black/40. If gradient needed, use bg-gradient-to-r from-black/70 to-transparent.

rules: Hover states on ALL interactive elements.
Spring physics for mood card interactions.
Real-time feedback animations for Group Carts and Payments.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards or WCAG AA minimum. Explicit hover text colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

media_and_images.rules: No placeholder text/URLs. Implement a robust Image Fallback component.

hero_group_orders.description: Friends sharing pizza indoors. Use for Group Orders feature.

tiffin_eco.description: Healthy meal prep boxes. Use for Daily Tiffin section.

route_level_hierarchy./: Home - Usable food app as the first screen (NO marketing landing page). Shows AI Concierge, Mood cards, Catalog.
route_level_hierarchy./auth/*: Premium Auth flows (Login, Signup, Forgot, Reset) with Emergent Google OAuth. Split screen layout.
route_level_hierarchy./restaurant/:id: Restaurant detail with real images, reviews, ratings.
route_level_hierarchy./concierge: Real AI Food Concierge grounded to catalog.
route_level_hierarchy./group: Real-time Group Orders dashboard: invite code, scannable QR, real-time participant cart updates.
route_level_hierarchy./checkout/success: Payment Result Success - Server verified status.

implementation_blueprint.auth: Implement JWT email/password + Emergent-managed Google Sign-In. Wrap app in AuthProvider. Use robust error handling.
implementation_blueprint.payment: Implement Stripe First. Use Stripe Checkout sessions. Handle success/cancel redirects gracefully with custom Radish Pink/Matcha Green UI.
implementation_blueprint.group_orders: Use WebSockets or polling for real-time state. Display active users and their contributions dynamically. Implement scannable QR flow.
implementation_blueprint.reviews: Add a Review Composer modal or page. Allow 1-5 star rating and text. Persist to MongoDB. Show aggregated ratings on Restaurant pages.
implementation_blueprint.image_fallback: Create a reusable <FallbackImage /> component that uses onError to switch to a styled fallback if the actual image fails to load.
implementation_blueprint.ui_ux: Perform a complete premium UI/UX pass. Ensure responsive design (desktop + mobile navigation). Enforce accessibility and E2E test IDs.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup complete route hierarchy in App.js including new Auth, Payment Result, and Review routes.
2. Implement Premium Auth components (/auth/login, /auth/signup, etc) using split-screen layout.
3. Implement `` component and replace all `` tags displaying food with it.
4. Build Stripe Payment Success/Cancel screens with appropriate branding (Matcha Green for success).
5. Enhance `/group` with Real-time participant status UI and functional QR code flow.
6. Build the Review Composer and integrate it into Order History.
7. Ensure the Profile page correctly reflects Authenticated states.
8. Perform a responsive pass: ensure the bottom nav is active on mobile, side/top nav on desktop.
9. Add data-testid attributes to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and forms for E2E testing.
10. Connect frontend UI to backend APIs correctly (Auth, Stripe, MongoDB, Real-time Group Orders). Do not use fake data for major flows.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters.
Apply 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use .js/.jsx extensions for all React component files, NOT .tsx.
